remove_evidence_spans: we investigated the elastic and plastic deformation behavior for the NbTaTiV BCC refractory HEA at RT and elevated temperatures, using in situ neutron experiments and theoretical approaches

update.evidence_span: the Kroner model is in the best agreement with the experimental data for all temperature ranges, as compared to the Voigt and Reuss models
update.content: Kroner's model agrees with measured elastic data better than Voigt and Reuss models.

update.evidence_span: the present alloy shows good mechanical stability in all temperature ranges
update.content: The measured elastic constants satisfy mechanical-stability criteria at all tested temperatures.

add.content: Earlier isotropic-HEA predictions lacked experimental verification.
add.evidence_span: However, their reported works have strongly focused on only theoretical calculations, due to the lack of experimental verifications

add.content: Yield strength falls from 1064 MPa at room temperature to 595 MPa at 900 degrees C.
add.evidence_span: The yield strength (σ y ) and work-hardening exponent ( N ) of the present alloy gradually decreased from 1064 MPa (RT) to 595 MPa (900°C)

add.content: The lattice parameter increases monotonically through 900 degrees C.
add.evidence_span: The lattice parameters of the present alloy at RT, 500°, 700°, and 900°C, which were determined by a single-peak fitting approach ( [18] ), are 3.2318, 3.2445, 3.2511, and 3.2588 Å, respectively

add.content: Temperature-associated volume change produces a large change in C11.
add.evidence_span: This change in volume is strongly associated with the temperature and, thus, corresponds to a relatively large change in C 11

add.content: The universal anisotropy index of zero confirms single-crystal isotropy.
add.evidence_span: the A U value for the NbTaTiV HEA is 0, which defines the single-crystal elastic properties to be isotropic

add.content: First-principles elastic moduli are within 6-17% of experiment.
add.evidence_span: The calculated elastic moduli at RT were less than the experimentally measured values by approximately −15.9, −16.6, and −6.0% for the Young’s, shear, and bulk moduli, respectively

add.content: Machine-learning shear and bulk moduli have relative errors of 2.5% and 6%.
add.evidence_span: The predicted shear modulus is 36.6 GPa, and the predicted bulk modulus is 146.3 GPa, giving relative errors of 2.5 and 6%, respectively

add.content: Compositional fluctuations both strengthen the alloy and hinder edge-dislocation motion.
add.evidence_span: This feature is induced by compositional fluctuations and, thus, leads to not only strengthening but also notable difficulty in the edge dislocation movement

add.content: Zener and Voigt-Reuss indices indicate near-perfect room-temperature isotropy.
add.evidence_span: the NbTaTiV refractory HEA manifests almost perfectly isotropic elastic deformation at RT ( A Z ≈ 1.2, A VR ≈ 0.0056, and VEC ≈ 4.68)
